articles.title: Shera Energy eyes 25-30% revenue growth in FY27, bets on capacity expansion
articles.summary: Jaipur-based Shera Energy is targeting an ambitious 25-30% revenue growth this financial year. This expansion will be fueled by significant capacity enhancement and the introduction of new value-added products. The company aims to strengthen its market presence by catering to crucial sectors, including power and related infrastructure. This strategic business growth highlights an important development in India's industrial landscape.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill Ukrainian woman as NATO jet downs drone over Romania
articles.summary: Ongoing Russian strikes in Ukraine resulted in one fatality and seven injuries, underscoring the conflict's human cost. Concurrently, a Spanish fighter jet, operating within NATO's air policing mission, successfully intercepted and shot down a drone that had violated Romanian airspace. This demonstrates vigilant airspace protection and heightened regional security posture amidst persistent geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: India has around 440 space technology startups: DPIIT Start-up India portal
articles.summary: India now hosts around 440 registered space technology startups, showcasing a burgeoning private sector. The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe) has authorized 113 firms, actively enabling private participation in space activities. This signifies India's commitment to fostering indigenous innovation, promoting self-reliance, and expanding its strategic capabilities in advanced space technology.

articles.title: Miami Dolphins' Jeff Hafley: 'People are so quick to judge' rookies
articles.summary: Jeff Hafley, the new coach for the Miami Dolphins, recently completed his first preseason game. The article highlights the prevalent lack of patience in the South Florida area concerning team performance, suggesting an immediate pressure on Hafley's tenure. This sets an early tone for his leadership in professional American football.
